saints.sourceTitle: The Saints of Ireland and Britain — Saint Brigid of Kildare
saints.dates: Fifth century; repose about 489 in Hutchison-Hall

summary.text: A bishop associated with Saint Brigid’s early religious life near Croghan Hill. He is distinguished here from the similarly named Maughold of the Isle of Man.
summary.reason: A concise source-bound account of the saint's life, identity and death; the linked modern source is not reproduced in full.
